title: The Ideology of Competition
coreMove: Notice when rivalry has become the frame that decides what you can see.
sourcePressure: The chapter asks why competition keeps moral prestige even when rivalry consumes attention and pushes companies into imitation. The frozen source for this chapter contains no chapter-specific named anecdote beyond author/editor metadata, so examples should use fictional protagonists and stay anchored to verified terms.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Reducing the idea to avoiding competitors instead of showing how rivalry captures attention.
